plot_beats: Walter White, a high school chemistry teacher in Albuquerque who also works at a car wash, turns 50.
At his birthday party his brother-in-law Hank Schrader, a DEA agent, shows TV coverage of a meth lab bust and the cash seized.
Walt collapses at the car wash and is diagnosed with inoperable lung cancer. He tells no one.
Walt rides along on a DEA raid and sees his former student Jesse Pinkman escape from the scene.
Walt tracks Jesse down and pressures him into a partnership: Walt will cook meth and Jesse will sell it.
They cook in an RV in the desert, producing unusually pure meth.
Jesse's contacts Krazy-8 and Emilio threaten them; Walt releases phosphine gas in the RV and knocks them out.
Hearing sirens, Walt prepares to shoot himself, but the sirens belong to fire trucks heading to a brush fire.

characters.name: Walter White
characters.status: Secretly cooking meth; has lung cancer
characters.new_info: Diagnosed with terminal lung cancer; starts cooking meth to provide for his family

characters.name: Jesse Pinkman
characters.role: Small-time meth dealer, Walt's former student

characters.name: Skyler White
characters.new_info: Pregnant with the couple's second child

open_threads: What happens to Krazy-8 and Emilio after the gas?
Walt has not told his family about the cancer
summary.cliffhanger: Walt stands in the desert with a gun as sirens approach, then realizes they are fire trucks.

plot_beats: Emilio is dead from the gas, but Krazy-8 survives.
Walt and Jesse chain Krazy-8 to a post in Jesse's basement.
Jesse tries to dissolve Emilio's body with hydrofluoric acid in his upstairs bathtub; the acid eats through the tub and floor and the remains crash down.
Skyler grows suspicious of Walt's absences and confronts Jesse by phone, thinking he is selling Walt marijuana.

characters.name: Walter White
characters.new_info: Lies to Skyler about where he goes

characters.name: Skyler White
characters.new_info: Warns Jesse to stop selling Walt pot

open_threads: What will Walt do with Krazy-8?
Skyler suspects Walt is hiding something
summary.cliffhanger: Emilio's dissolved remains crash through the ceiling.

plot_beats: Walt agonizes over killing Krazy-8 and writes a list of reasons to let him live or kill him.
Walt and Krazy-8 talk and find some connection; Walt decides to let him go.
Walt notices a shard of a broken plate is missing and realizes Krazy-8 is hiding it as a weapon.
When Krazy-8 lunges with the shard, Walt strangles him with a bike lock.
Hank takes Walt Jr. to see a meth addict to scare him off drugs.
Walt finally tells Skyler he has lung cancer.

characters.name: Walter White
characters.new_info: Kills for the first time; tells Skyler about his cancer

characters.name: Krazy-8
characters.new_info: Killed by Walt after hiding a plate shard

characters.name: Walter White Jr.
characters.new_info: Hank tries to scare him away from drugs

open_threads: How will the family react to the cancer?
summary.cliffhanger: Walt tells Skyler he has cancer.

plot_beats: Walt tells the extended family about his cancer.
Hank tells his DEA team about a new, very pure meth in town.
Walt sees an oncologist who recommends expensive treatment the family can't easily afford.
Jesse visits his parents, who throw him out after finding a joint that belongs to his younger brother.
A rude businessman takes Walt's parking spot and insults him; Walt sets the man's car on fire by shorting its battery.

characters.name: Walter White
characters.new_info: Takes revenge on a rude businessman by destroying his car

characters.name: Jesse Pinkman
characters.new_info: His parents kick him out again

open_threads: How will Walt pay for treatment?
Hank is investigating the new meth
summary.cliffhanger: Walt walks away as the businessman's car burns.

plot_beats: Walt and Skyler attend a party thrown by Walt's wealthy former partner Elliott and his wife Gretchen.
Elliott offers Walt a job with health insurance at their company, Gray Matter; Walt refuses.
Jesse tries to go straight, fails, and starts cooking with his friend Badger, producing poor meth.
At a family intervention, Walt says he doesn't want treatment, then agrees to it.
Walt goes to Jesse and asks if he wants to cook again.
relationships_changed: Walt and Jesse resume their partnership
open_threads: Walt still needs money for treatment
summary.cliffhanger: Walt asks Jesse to start cooking with him again.

plot_beats: Walt starts chemotherapy and shaves his head.
Walt tells Jesse he will cook but wants no part of violence or selling.
Hank investigates stolen lab equipment from Walt's school; the janitor is wrongly arrested.
Jesse tries to sell a large amount of meth to the distributor Tuco Salamanca, who beats him and takes the drugs.
Walt, calling himself Heisenberg, confronts Tuco and blows up his office with fulminated mercury disguised as meth.
Tuco pays Walt for the stolen meth and Jesse's injuries and agrees to do business.

characters.name: Walter White
characters.status: In chemotherapy; doing business with Tuco
characters.new_info: Adopts the name Heisenberg and intimidates Tuco with an explosion

characters.name: Tuco Salamanca
characters.new_info: Beats Jesse; is forced to pay Walt

relationships_changed: Walt and Jesse begin working with Tuco
open_threads: Hank is closing in on the stolen equipment
summary.cliffhanger: Walt walks out of Tuco's wrecked office with the money.

plot_beats: Walt promises Tuco two pounds of meth a week.
Needing more methylamine, Walt and Jesse use thermite to break into a chemical warehouse and steal a barrel.
Skyler tries to return a baby tiara her sister Marie gave her and is accused of shoplifting; Marie stole it.
Walt and Jesse deliver to Tuco at a junkyard.
Tuco beats his own henchman No-Doze to death in front of them for speaking out of turn.

characters.name: Marie Schrader
characters.new_info: Shoplifts and gave Skyler a stolen tiara

open_threads: Walt and Jesse are now tied to a violent, erratic distributor
summary.cliffhanger: Walt and Jesse watch, horrified, as Tuco beats No-Doze to death.

forbidden.event: Gus Fring or Los Pollos Hermanos (introduced in season 2)
